content: warren's spawn flow forwards agent.name (the canopy prompt name) to burrow as the 'agentId' in POST /burrows/:id/runs. burrow looks up agentId in its runtime registry to pick an executor. Built-in runtimes are 'claude-code', 'sapling', 'codex' (see burrow's knownBuiltInIds). A canopy prompt tagged 'agent' that should drive claude-code MUST be named 'claude-code' — naming it 'hello-bot' or anything else makes burrow accept the run but never execute it (no registered runtime), and the warren reap immediately marks it failed even though branchPushed:true and errors:[]. Custom runtimes can be registered via burrow.toml [[agents]] but the default path is name = built-in id.

description: A transient provider network drop (reap.provider_error 'Network connection lost.') terminalizes a run failed/provider_error with NO retry — mid-run uncommitted work destroyed with the workspace. Observed run_htwpffq19pmr (pi + openrouter), $0.58 lost.
resolution: Re-dispatch immediately with the same prompt (fresh clone re-fetches). warren-6016 (merged PR #814) now lets salvage rescue the dirty tree. Filed warren-339d for in-run retry.

name: github-app-manifest-flow-empirics
description: GitHub App manifest-flow empirics for the Forge campaign (spike 2026-08-11, seed warren-bc4c, full evidence in docs/design/forge-contract.md §7): loopback redirect_url (http://127.0.0.1) works in the App manifest flow; POST /app-manifests/{code}/conversions needs NO auth and the code is single-use (201 then 404); PUT /pulls/:n/merge accepts a fine-grained PAT with only contents=write (X-Accepted-GitHub-Permissions); an App cannot approve its own PR (422). Installation tokens observed in the stateless ghs_ format at 383 chars — never assume token length. App installation tokens CAN read check-runs; fine-grained PATs cannot.

name: cancel-intent-via-event-log
description: Cancel intent as an event-log record: the durable signal that warren itself deleted a run's pod is the cancel.requested event (EventsRepo.hasKind), which the watchdog terminal-reconcile net reads to flip exists:false from failed/sandbox_run_lost to cancelled. Pairs with a shorter cancel fast-path grace (WARREN_RUN_CANCEL_RECONCILE_GRACE_MS, default 15s) so deliberate stops reconcile in seconds-to-a-minute instead of waiting the full terminal-reconcile grace.

name: infra-lost-auto-retry
description: warren-4af7 infra-lost auto-retry: the runs.retry_of back-link IS the one-retry budget (no attempt counter). Retry hook (src/runs/retry.ts) fires from reapRun + reconcileLostBurrowRun via an optional onInfraLostRun seam threaded from boot (src/server/main/retry-wiring.ts); the bridge registry is late-bound through bootBridges' onRegistryCreated so boot-time ghost-reconcile retries still attach a bridge. Plan-run children stand down via planRuns.findChildByRunId — the coordinator retry shape (src/plan-runs/retry.ts) owns them; new retryable causes join by appending to RETRYABLE_CHILD_FAILURE_REASONS. Cumulative spend: retry dispatches with maxCostUsdOverride = original cap minus first-attempt costUsd.

name: pr-body-fragments
description: PR-body sections are fragments in src/runs/pr-template.ts (PR_FRAGMENT_NAMES, order = body order). New dynamic sections: add fragment name + PrFragmentContext field + defaultRender case, thread data via gatherPrContext (src/runs/reap/pr-context.ts) → tryOpenPr → buildPrContent. composeBody's 64KB clamp (clampPrBodyLength) covers all fragments; fence agent-authored markdown that may contain ## headers.

title: ref-dispatch no_changes failure reason
rationale: Shepherding loops read plain succeeded as fixed; silent no-op on a repair branch burned CI rounds. Surfacing no_changes on the run record makes the outcome unmistakable without changing dropped_commit semantics.

name: dispatch-context-writer
description: dispatch-context writer (warren-d6ca): writeDispatchContext lives in src/runs/spawn/dispatch-context.ts and is called from spawnRun immediately after runs.create / onRunRowCreated, BEFORE provider.create. Fire-and-log like writeSeedExtensions. Cap-source tier must read PRE-fold frontmatter (baseAgent) so a project default folded onto the frozen envelope is not mis-attributed as frontmatter. Retry lineage: derive retry_kind from dispatchOrigin (retry_infra_lost/retry_provider) falling back to row shape; walk retry_of (infra) or retry_of??parent_run_id (provider) for attempt_no/root_run_id. Plan-child retries carry no run-row marker so kind stays none.

name: basecommit-ref-split
description: baseCommit/ref split (warren-aaf7): ref stays branch-shaped and feeds the reap PR base (run.ref ?? defaultBranch, src/runs/reap/run.ts); baseCommit (40-hex) overrides only the workspace cut (baseRef = input.baseCommit ?? resolveContinuationRef). Validation lives at src/runs/base-commit.ts, called from the HTTP handler; spawnRun trusts callers. Budget guard: src/ui/src/api/types.ts sits at its frozen 776-line ceiling — new fields there must save a line elsewhere in the file.

name: repoContext-onboarding-block
description: repoContext (warren-540f): per-project .warren/config.yaml onboarding block flows DefaultsConfigSchema -> readProjectDefaults -> composeDispatchPrompt(system, user, repoContext) between system and user prompt with --- delimiters; bytes counted in dispatch-context promptBytes. Complexity ceiling in assembleWriteInput (dispatch-context.ts) is at 15 — new optional input fields must be assigned in writeDispatchContext after assembleWriteInput, not inside it. Also: check:size counts test files; split new tests into their own <500-line file.

name: per-project-clone-serialization-detached-head-basecommit
description: per-project clone serialization + detached-HEAD baseCommit materialization (warren-232d): withProjectCloneLock (src/projects/clone-lock.ts) wraps the whole spawnRun body keyed by projectId — non-reentrant, tail-chained so a failed dispatch never wedges the queue; baseCommit dispatches refresh in fetch-only mode (RefreshProjectCloneInput.fetchCommit: git fetch origin <sha> with full-fetch fallback + cat-file verify, HEAD untouched) and cut the workspace via worktree add -b <branch> <ws> <sha>; migration-preflight must skip baseCommit dispatches (heal would commit on the wrong base); materializeProjectWorkspace no longer hard-codes 'main' as the fallback base — it throws when createBranch lacks baseBranch

name: repair-run-commits-ahead-pre-push-origin-tip
description: Ref-dispatch repair runs (branch === baseBranch) cannot count commits_ahead as base..HEAD — HEAD is attached to the base so the range is empty by construction. finalize pins the pre-push origin/<base> tip with git rev-parse BEFORE branch_push (the push rewrites the tracking ref), counts rev-list <sha>..HEAD after, and reports FinalizeResult.commitsAheadBase so recordOutcomeFacts diffs the same ref. An unresolvable tracking ref fails commits_ahead to null — never fall back to base..HEAD (a structural false 0). See repairBaseTrackingRef in src/runs/reap/util.ts (#1022, warren-ba08).

Contributor PR #994 moved commits_ahead BEFORE branch_push and added an origin/<base> -> <base> fallback. Both broke the contract: five finalize stage-trail tests pin push-then-count order, and the fallback silently re-introduced the structural 0 it was fixing. Gemini-generated diffs also rewrote \\t escapes to literal tabs in untouched lines of outcome-facts.ts.
resolution: Keep the branch_push -> commits_ahead trail; move only the ref RESOLUTION earlier (rev-parse origin/<base> pre-push), count post-push against the SHA, fail to null when the tracking ref is missing. Diff the whole file of a generated PR, not just the hunk you care about (#1022).

description: OpenRouter upstream stream errors killed 8 consecutive dogfood runs on 2026-08-19/20 across two models (deepseek-v4-pro-0813 via Together: identical 'h2 protocol error' 4/4; kimi-k3: 'idle timeout exceeded'/'stream ended unexpectedly'). OpenRouter status was green the whole time — the errors are upstream-compute-provider stream drops relayed through OpenRouter, and multi-hour agent runs holding one streaming connection are maximally exposed. Root-cause amplifier: agent image pinned pi 0.83.0, missing 0.84.0's stream-robustness fixes (finish_reason-omitting stream support = the warren-d451 class, provider-retry settings fix, longer connect timeout).
resolution: Bumped pi to 0.84.2 in both image pins (PR #1024, seed warren-d065) and rolled GKE (deploy sha eaff90a0). First post-rollout run (run_8njtm1zkesat, warren-cb93 attempt 5) succeeded after 4 straight predecessor deaths. When a model route fails repeatedly with the SAME upstream error, stop re-dispatching and fix the stack instead.

name: live-repro-before-dispatch
description: Dogfood pipeline: before dispatching a run for a reported-live bug, attempt the cheap reproduction yourself against the live instance. warren-7e28 ('events endpoint >120s on a running run') was closed with zero run spend by timing GET /runs/:id/events?limit=N against both terminal and RUNNING runs (0.3-0.95s) during another run's dispatch window — the observation predated the deployed fix (#789). The poller doing dispatch-watching doubles as the repro harness: measure the reported symptom against a run you already have in flight.

Dogfood observations from the live instance can describe a bug already fixed at HEAD: warren-42a3 (retryOf=null on provider retries) was observed on deploy f5374c48 (08-19T03:01Z) but PR #985 had stamped retryOf at provider-retry.ts:325 since 08-19T15:28Z; the first deploy containing it was eaff90a0 (08-20T13:40Z).
resolution: Before filing a bug from a live run, compare the run's timestamp against the deploy-gke SHA timeline (gh run list -w deploy-gke) and the fix's merge time; the code at HEAD is the tiebreaker, not the tracker row. Closed 42a3 citing #985 during the 2026-08-20 good-first-issue batch.

name: system-stream-failure-classifier-arm
description: Adding a new infra failure shape to reap classification (pattern from warren-4e2a, reused in warren-950d): export a stable message prefix constant from the module that emits the system-stream error (e.g. UID_DROP_PREFLIGHT_ERROR_PREFIX in src/runtime/k8s/agent-uid-drop.ts), then match it in src/runs/reap/state.ts anchored to stream==='system' (only warren-owned writers pass the provenance gate) and fold it into both inferFailureReason and detectSpawnExecFailure so spawn-class failures also skip the seeds commit + branch push. Never match on stdout/stderr text — an agent printing the phrase must not reclassify its own crash.

title: Live K8s repo-cache is an RWX Filestore claim
rationale: Run pods schedule across multiple Autopilot nodes, so an RWO claim deadlocks on Multi-Attach (warren-554f); openclaw's 2.9GB clone made the ~$160-200/mo Filestore minimum a confirmed payer (owner call in warren-8175).
